description: a 4 × 4 plate 1 thick with a conical hole through it, radius 0.5 at the bottom and 1 at the top, written by Open CASCADE with every closed edge split in two (ShapeUpgrade_ShapeDivideClosedEdges): the top rim is two half circles between the top and the cone, the cone's seam at (3, 2, 1) and nothing but the two arcs at (1, 2, 1), a vertex of two edges (ADR-0041). One half of the rim filleted at r 0.2: a plane against a cone along a circle coaxial with it, convex, the chain runs on through both vertices and closes as a whole ring, two half tori coaxial with the hole, the cone's seam shortened to the contact on the cone
